A polished miniature fantasy animal toy, soft sculpted fur and feather detail, warm studio light, friendly noble expression. No horse head, horse mane, hooves or horn. NO rider, no saddle, no reins. Important: keep a comfortable visible riding seat on the middle of the back behind the shoulders, like the reference. Entire sheet: EXACTLY 3 columns by 3 rows of EQUAL square cells, nine full-body creatures total, all facing RIGHT in side/three-quarter view. Reference images have a technical green backdrop: IGNORE IT, output a TRUE transparent background, no coloured backing, no ground, no cast shadows, no halo, no text or grid lines. Each creature must fit completely within its own cell with generous margins for all wings, tail and talons, no touching neighboring cells. Keep head/torso size CONSISTENT across all nine poses; do not enlarge crouches. Match each reference frame's main body placement and standing baseline as closely as possible. Row 2 running/flight: 1 long galloping stride, wings lifted; 2 gathered galloping stride, wings halfway down; 3 alternate extended stride with wings out/back in a glide. Row 3 jumping: 1 compressed takeoff with forelegs lifted, wings starting to rise; 2 airborne ascending/apex pose with legs tucked, wings lifted; 3 landing pose with forefeet reaching ground, wings half-folded. A cohesive game-ready sheet of one griffon in nine distinct clearly readable poses.
